world.title: Why Trump's plan to unleash 'Mother Of All Bombs' may fall flat in Iran
world.summary: Military discussions are exploring the use of the 'Mother of All Bombs' (MOAB) against Iran's nuclear facilities and military targets. However, analysts argue that the MOAB may not be effective against deeply buried sites fortified with reinforced concrete. The bomb's capabilities may not align with the specific challenges posed by Iran's infrastructure, raising concerns about its potential impact.

world.title: Protests spread across France as ‘yellow vests’ set to join
world.summary: Protests in France have expanded since mid-September, initially starting at schools and now involving high school students, trade unions, and "yellow vest" activists. Demonstrations are expected nationwide, reflecting broader grievances among various groups. The situation remains uncertain as the country prepares for potential unrest, with many anticipating significant participation in the upcoming protests across multiple cities.

world.title: Iran’s IRGC warns Strait of Hormuz is closed after supertanker catches fire
world.summary: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) announced the closure of the Strait of Hormuz following a fire on a supertanker carrying over 2 million barrels of crude oil. The vessel reportedly struck a naval mine, leading to the incident. The IRGC's statement emphasizes the strategic importance of the strait, a crucial route for global oil transportation.

business.title: ICICI Bank’s Sandeep Batra says bank has strong internal succession bench, wishes Bagchi 'the very best' after exit
business.summary: ICICI Bank's executive director Sandeep Batra expressed confidence in the bank's internal talent pipeline following the departure of Bagchi, the outgoing chief of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance. Bagchi is set to assume the role of MD and CEO at HDFC Bank. Batra wished him well in his new position, emphasizing the strength of ICICI Bank's succession planning.

business.title: HDFC Bank deputy MD Kaizad Bharucha announces decision to quit ahead of Anup Bagchi's takeover as CEO
business.summary: HDFC Bank Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha has announced his resignation, effective December 31. This decision comes ahead of Anup Bagchi's upcoming takeover as CEO. The bank confirmed Bharucha's departure in an exchange filing on Saturday. His exit marks a significant change in leadership at India's largest private sector lender as it prepares for a new management structure.

business.title: One last bittersweet pitch for HDFC Bank as CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan prepares to exit
business.summary: HDFC Bank CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan will step down on October 26 after opting not to seek a second term. He expressed confidence in the bank's resilience and growth, noting its successful navigation through regulatory challenges, the Covid-19 pandemic, a complex merger, and monetary tightening. Jagdishan also stated that governance issues have been resolved, ensuring the bank's stability.

technology.title: Global / Indian OnePlus 16 variant under testing with three model numbers
technology.summary: OnePlus is currently testing the OnePlus 16 for global and Indian markets, identified by three model numbers, indicating a potential wider release. The recently launched OnePlus 16 in China features an 185Hz OLED display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip, and a 9,000mAh battery with 100W charging. Additionally, a OnePlus 16R variant has also emerged.

technology.title: known eSIM trick lets you finally share your data connection
technology.source: Futura, le média qui explore le monde
technology.summary: Data eSIMs have emerged as a convenient solution for maintaining internet connectivity while traveling. They eliminate the need to change physical SIM cards when crossing borders or switching carriers. Users can purchase data plans from various carriers or specialist providers, simplifying the process of staying connected abroad. This technology enhances travel experiences by providing seamless access to mobile data.

technology.title: Samsung announces festive offers on Vision AI TVs, Soundbars with cashback, and more
technology.summary: Samsung India has launched its 'Big, Bigger, Biggest' festive campaign, featuring promotional offers on Vision AI TVs and soundbars. The campaign includes cashback, bundled products, and financing benefits to attract customers during the festive season. These deals aim to enhance the shopping experience for consumers looking for home entertainment solutions. The offers are available across various retail channels.

sports.title: Injured Litton Das out of ODI tri-series, Hridoy to lead
sports.summary: Bangladesh's ODI captain Litton Kumar Das has been ruled out of the ongoing tri-nation series in the UAE due to a hip injury. The Bangladesh Cricket Board announced his absence on Saturday. In his place, Najmul Hossain Shanto will lead the team. The series includes matches against Zimbabwe and Afghanistan, with Litton unable to participate.

sports.title: Injured Litton Das out of ODI tri-series, Hridoy to lead
sports.summary: Bangladesh's ODI captain Litton Kumar Das has been ruled out of the ongoing tri-nation series in the UAE due to a hip injury. The Bangladesh Cricket Board announced his absence on Saturday, stating that Litton would not participate in matches against Zimbabwe and Afghanistan. In his place, Najmul Hossain Shanto will lead the team during the series.

sports.title: Sony Sports to telecast India A games in New Zealand
sports.summary: Sony Sports will broadcast three four-day matches featuring India A in New Zealand, led by Dhruv Jurel. This series serves as a preparatory tour ahead of the Test series. The matches are scheduled from October 24 to 27, October 31 to November 3, and November 7 to 10. The telecast aims to engage cricket fans during this period.

health.title: ICAR-NIVEDI, Bengaluru Expands NABL Accreditation to 28 Veterinary Diagnostic Tests
health.summary: ICAR-NIVEDI in Bengaluru has expanded its NABL accreditation under ISO/IEC 17025:2017 to include 28 veterinary diagnostic tests. This expansion encompasses major livestock diseases, zoonotic infections, and antimicrobial resistance (AMR). The accreditation, granted by the National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories, marks a significant milestone for the institute in enhancing veterinary diagnostic capabilities.

health.title: Can a blood test detect breast cancer early?
health.summary: Routine blood tests and tumor markers are not effective for screening healthy individuals for early-stage breast cancer, despite rising interest in preventive health care. Breast cancer is prevalent among women, and early detection significantly enhances treatment outcomes. Current research indicates that blood tests cannot reliably identify breast cancer in asymptomatic individuals, underscoring the need for alternative screening methods.

science.title: Orionid meteor shower lights southeastern sky October 21 and 22
science.summary: The Orionid meteor shower will peak overnight on October 21-22, providing an opportunity to see 10 to 20 meteors per hour. Optimal viewing conditions will occur after midnight, following the moon's set. Stargazers are encouraged to head outside during this time to enjoy the celestial display, which is expected to light up the southeastern sky.

science.title: 10,000 New Faults and Impact on Earth
science.summary: The Moon is gradually shrinking due to its cooling interior, resulting in approximately 10,000 new faults, cracks, and ridges on its surface. Scientists are studying these geological changes to gain insights into the Moon's evolution and assess any potential implications for Earth. The findings raise concerns about how these developments may affect our planet in the future.

science.title: The PUFFINS Telescope Mission
science.summary: Dr. Ramya Anche, an astronomer from Bengaluru, has been appointed as the Principal Investigator for NASA’s $20-million PUFFINS space telescope mission. This selection highlights a significant achievement for an Indian-origin scientist in the field of astronomy. The mission aims to enhance our understanding of the universe and contribute valuable data to ongoing research in astrophysics.

entertainment.title: Chhota Sidhu gun gestures: Child rights body seeks Mansa inquiry
entertainment.summary: A child rights organization has requested an inquiry from Mansa authorities in Punjab regarding Chhota Sidhu's gun gestures during a concert in Toronto. The complaint emphasizes the need for parental counseling and protective measures for the welfare of 2.5-year-old Sukhdeep Singh Sidhu, the child of singer Sidhu Moosewala, following concerns raised about his behavior.

entertainment.title: Sandeep Reddy Vanga Calls Vijay Deverakonda The Next Defining Action Hero Of Indian Cinema After Watching Ranabaali
entertainment.summary: Filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga has praised Vijay Deverakonda's performance in the film Ranabaali, calling him the next defining action hero of Indian cinema. Vanga, who previously worked with Vijay on Arjun Reddy, commended the actor's portrayal of the titular character and encouraged audiences to watch the film in theatres, highlighting Vijay's impressive action sequences. Rashmika Mandanna co-stars.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, October 18, 2026: Tomorrow could bring a fresh start, but letting go of old expectations may be the hardest part
entertainment.summary: On October 18, 2026, horoscopes suggest a potential fresh start, emphasizing the importance of releasing old expectations. Seeking advice from experienced individuals or returning to stable routines may be beneficial. While imagination is valuable, practical judgment is crucial for distinguishing realistic options from distractions. Caution is advised against making commitments without careful consideration of the situation.
